gloss: to gather together; to collect; to scrape together

definitions.gloss: to gather together; to collect; to scrape together
definitions.explanation: To bring various things or people together from different places. Often implies gathering miscellaneous or disparate items rather than a neat, organized collection.

examples.japanese: {資料|しりょう}を{寄|よ}せ{集|あつ}めた。
{残|のこ}り{物|もの}を{寄|よ}せ{集|あつ}めて{夕食|ゆうしょく}を{作|つく}った。
examples.english: I scraped together the leftovers and made dinner.

examples.japanese: {各地|かくち}から{専門家|せんもんか}を{寄|よ}せ{集|あつ}めて{緊急|きんきゅう}の{対策|たいさく}チームを{作|つく}った。
examples.english: They assembled a team of experts gathered from around the country to form an emergency response unit.

notes:
Ichidan verb ({一段|いちだん}). Transitive — takes を for the things gathered.

The compound combines {寄|よ}せる (to bring near) and {集|あつ}める (to collect). Often carries a nuance of assembling things hastily or from scattered sources, unlike {集|あつ}める alone which is more neutral.

The noun form {寄|よ}せ{集|あつ}め means 'a motley collection' or 'hodgepodge,' often with a slightly negative tone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {情報|じょうほう}を{寄|よ}せ{集|あつ}める (to gather information from various sources)
- {人|ひと}を{寄|よ}せ{集|あつ}める (to round up people)
- {資金|しきん}を{寄|よ}せ{集|あつ}める (to scrape together funds)
